correctness.rationale: The syntheme/duad incidence graph has 15+15 vertices and 45 branches; ordinary triple points have normalization delta=2 and arithmetic genus 16. For each extension degree, normalization counts fixed syntheme P1 lines minus fixed flags plus fixed duads, giving the claimed zeta factors. Independently generated the 15 perfect matchings, 15 duads and 45 flags, enumerated all 720 permutations, found exactly 11 cycle types, 9 distinct complete zeta signatures and 144 rational-point-free five-cycles, with all relevant orbits of length five. The 5-cycle graph-cover integral character lattice is ker((h_i-1):Z[C5]^4 ->Z[C5]); a nontrivial loop monodromy exists because the lifted graph is connected, and C5 prime ensures a generator. Elementary integral group-ring operations reduce the boundary to (h-1,0,0,0), hence the kernel Z ⊕ Z[C5]^3 and the claimed k-torus isomorphism, not just an isogeny. Full singular-line intersection determinant claims are supplied in source verification but not independently regenerated; this limits the separate local-geometry check.
